nodes.description: Public constant string symbol = "ELTC" stored in contract state.
Public constant string name = "eLTC" stored in contract state.
Public constant uint8 decimals = 8 stored in contract state.
uint256 _totalSupply = 8400000 * 10**8, the fixed token supply.
address public owner; privileged account set in the constructor and used by onlyOwner.
mapping(address => uint256) balances; token balance ledger mutated with unchecked arithmetic.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger.
Constructor ELTC(): sets owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the owner.
Modifier onlyOwner(): require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate.
distributeELTC(address[]) onlyOwner: loops and moves 1000000000000 units from owner to each address with unchecked arithmetic.
totalSupply() constant returns the stored _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address) constant returns balances[_owner].
transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to using unchecked balance arithmetic.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens via allowance using unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
approve(address,uint256): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount.
allowance(address,address) constant returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfer and allowance logic.
balances[owner] -= 1000000000000 in distributeELTC; unchecked subtraction can underflow.
balances[addresses[i]] += 1000000000000 in distributeELTC; unchecked addition can overflow.
balances[msg.sender] -= _amount in transfer; unchecked subtraction.
balances[_to] += _amount in transfer; unchecked addition guarded only by a weak overflow check.
balances[_from] -= _amount in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction.
balances[_to] += _amount in transferFrom; unchecked addition.
address[] addresses parameter of distributeELTC, iterated to pick recipients.
address _owner parameter of balanceOf.
address _to parameter of transfer, credited with tokens.
uint256 _amount parameter of transfer, size of the balance move.
address _from parameter of transferFrom, debited account.
address _to parameter of transferFrom, credited account.
uint256 _amount parameter of transferFrom, size of the balance/allowance move.
address _spender parameter of approve, allowance key.
uint256 _amount parameter of approve, allowance value written.
address _owner parameter of allowance lookup.
address _spender parameter of allowance lookup.
uint i loop counter in distributeELTC.
uint256 totalSupply return variable of totalSupply().
uint256 balance return variable of balanceOf().
bool success return variable of transfer().
bool success return variable of transferFrom().

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to establish the privileged owner.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender value flows into the owner state variable, granting privileges.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
onlyOwner modifier controls whether distributeELTC body executes.
distributeELTC authorization depends on caller identity via msg.sender.
addresses parameter array drives the distributeELTC loop.
Loop index i controls iteration count of distributeELTC.
Loop index i selects addresses[i] used as the credited account.
Recipient taken from the addresses parameter flows into the balance increment.
distributeELTC executes the unchecked balances[owner] subtraction.
distributeELTC executes the unchecked recipient balance addition.
distributeELTC mutates the balances mapping with unchecked arithmetic.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer executes balances[msg.sender] -= _amount without safe math.
transfer executes balances[_to] += _amount with only a weak overflow guard.
transfer writes the balances mapping.
_amount parameter determines the sender balance subtraction.
_amount parameter determines the recipient balance addition.
_to parameter is the key credited in balances.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance lookup, so authorization depends on the caller.
transferFrom executes balances[_from] -= _amount without safe math.
transferFrom executes allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount without safe math.
transferFrom executes balances[_to] += _amount with only a weak overflow guard.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed allowance mapping.
_amount parameter drives the _from balance subtraction.
_amount parameter drives the allowance subtraction.
_amount parameter drives the _to balance addition.
_from parameter is the key debited in balances.
_to parameter is the key credited in balances.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender as the owner of the funds.
_spender parameter is used as the allowance key.
_amount parameter is written into the allowance value.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
_owner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
_owner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
_spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
totalSupply local return value is produced by the totalSupply function.
balance local return value is produced by balanceOf.
success local return value is produced by transfer.
success local return value is produced by transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The addresses array parameter only reaches the unsafe recipient balance increment; fold it into that unsafe operation.
_owner parameter is only used to index balances inside balanceOf; fold it into the balanceOf function.
_to parameter only supplies the credited key for the transfer increment; fold it into that unsafe operation.
_amount parameter only sizes the sender balance subtraction in transfer; fold it into that unsafe operation.
_from parameter only supplies the debited key in transferFrom; fold it into that unsafe operation.
_to parameter only supplies the credited key in transferFrom; fold it into that unsafe operation.
_amount parameter sizes the transferFrom debits; fold it into the _from balance subtraction.
_spender parameter is only used as the approve allowance key; fold it into the approve function.
_amount parameter is only written as the approve allowance value; fold it into the approve function.
_owner parameter is only used to index allowed in allowance; fold it into the allowance function.
_spender parameter is only used to index allowed in allowance; fold it into the allowance function.
The loop counter i exists only to drive distributeELTC iteration; fold it into that function.
The totalSupply return local is only produced by the totalSupply function; fold it in.
The balance return local is only produced by balanceOf; fold it in.
The success return local is only produced by transfer; fold it in.
The success return local is only produced by transferFrom; fold it in.
